create_file_storage_observer: create a FileStorageObserver instance to log experiment runs to a specified base directory on disk
use_file_storage_cli_option: use the file_storage_option CLI flag to add a FileStorageObserver to a Sacred experiment run
save_experiment_metrics: save experiment metrics with values, steps, and timestamps to a metrics.json file via log_metrics
render_mako_template_report: render a Mako HTML template report from run data, config, info, and captured output
save_experiment_sources_and_resources: save experiment source files and resource files to dedicated directories using find_or_save with MD5 deduplication
